prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL premium hand painted 2D fairy tale game vegetation asset family. True transparent RGBA background. 1536x1024 landscape atlas in THREE columns and TWO rows, six distinct COMPLETE isolated ROOTED plants, no text, labels, grids, frames, floor plane, shadows cast on background, no scenery. Use attached painting strictly for the gouache brushwork, soft upper-left light, restrained yellow-green moss colours and cool lavender-grey shade relationship; do NOT paint limestone rectangles.

Each512x512cell contains exactly one entire plant, including ALL branching tips and an exposed convincing root flare/low root tendrils. Keep32px transparent empty margins around every cell, and at least48px transparent clear separation from neighbours. All roots terminate naturally inside the cell, no hard horizontal bottom cuts, no canopy slices and no ground strip. Complete coherent silhouettes, exquisite but controlled brushwork, painted rather than vector/photoreal. Each piece is designed for MIDDLE DISTANCE in a game, readable branching negative spaces; no tiny flowers enlarged into trees. These six share one botanical habitat and painting style.

Top row LEFT: low wind-bent small hawthorn tree, sinuous branched trunk and sparse rounded yellow green leaf masses, exposed spreading ROOT flare at foot,440px high, crown340px wide, entire shape visible.
Top row CENTRE: slightly taller graceful young birch/hazel tree, asymmetric rising branches with airy sage green canopy, ivory bark with lavender shadows, full root base visible,440pxhigh crown300pxwide.
Top row RIGHT: dense rounded rooted shrub with curved woody stems and muted small leaves, approximately280px high and380pxwide, clearly rooted at bottom, not hovering.
Bottom row LEFT: low asymmetric rooted meadow shrub with crooked woody branching and a few pale seedheads,250pxhigh and360pxwide, full tiny roots visible.
Bottom row CENTRE: graceful tuft of marsh reeds and sedges, many slender arching sage/yellow green blades and a few tawny seed heads,380pxhigh and260pxwide, complete intertwined root crown at foot, no pond/ground.
Bottom row RIGHT: bent windblown reed cluster, lighter warm straw/sage palette,330pxhigh and310pxwide, entire blades and root crown visible.

Every plant root foot aligns approximately to y456 of its own512pxcell, vegetation stays inside margins. Upper-left broad diffuse sunlight, no rim glow. Avoid oversaturated emerald, black outlines, blurry soft blobs, artificial shiny leaves, mushrooms, giant flowers or freestanding rock piles. This is a reusable coherent asset family for an existing commercial hand-painted platform game, not a contact sheet of unrelated styles.
